what: The giant footer wordmark is drawn with a shader — when visible, each letter column drops from above over 1.7s expo.inOut at .15s intervals and settles, and when the cursor passes, ink spreads there (brush .64 · fade .926/frame · cursor follow .081) turning text-colored letters into accent-colored letters, and the image is pushed by cursor speed then springs back (damping .93 · pull .005 · push 2.18, distortion 9.18 · refraction .072). Drawn coarsely at 150 pixel rows, with ink edges made by 20px grid dither

options.ink: Ratio of ink that remains (per frame), default .92559
options.push: Push amount by cursor speed, default 2.18
options.pixels: Number of vertical pixel rows (0 turns it off), default 150
options.dither: If 1, ink edges use a grid dither, default 1
options.dur: Time for one letter to come down (s), default 1.7
options.threshold: Ratio at which it starts when visible, default .2
options.[data-fx-part=word]: Wordmark text (vertical column of up to 8 characters) — font, weight and color are carried onto the canvas as is. The size of the attached element sets the canvas

note: Normal text uses the text color, the ink spot uses --kf-accent. three loads _vendor/three@0.182.0 as window.THREE. Ink spreads only with a mouse (on touch, only the letters dropping down)
